visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a red header containing a cartoon face logo and white text. A detailed illustration of sliced pork belly with green scallions sits on a white plate against a black background. At the bottom, yellow text asks a question. (2) The pork dish suddenly gains green lettuce leaves underneath. A cartoon farmer character appears, wearing a straw hat and smiling broadly, holding a basket overflowing with various vegetables like carrots and corn, surrounded by small colorful flowers. (3) A cartoon male character with blue hair and a grey t-shirt appears, pointing his finger upwards. Two pork dishes are shown side-by-side for comparison: one plain and one with lettuce. The background remains dark with stylized yellow text at the bottom. (4) A round white mascot character with a confused expression appears, holding a small 'Vit C' logo. The blue-haired character continues to gesture while a green cabbage icon with a face float above him. (5) Five identical cartoon female characters in pink aprons appear in a row. A blue 'MENU' board shows two meal options with text and price symbols, one with vegetables and one without. (6) A plate of shrimp is shown with and without lemon and greens. The blue-haired character reappears holding a white sheet of paper, looking informative against a plain background. (7) A cartoon cabbage with a face falls from above. A graphic of a steak on a plate is shown; a score of '7' appears and then increases to '8.08' as broccoli and parsley are added. (8) A gift box wrapped in heart-patterned paper is shown, which then reveals a bento box filled with colorful vegetables and meat. (9) The male character looks thoughtful with his hand on his chin. Three blue bubbles containing negative personality trait text float around his head. (10) The male character holds a large cabbage and speaks close to the camera. The white mascot reappears with a bright red tomato balanced on its head, looking slightly stressed. (11) The mascot shakes and looks distraught with wide eyes while the male character looks down sadly. The background is a simple split of pink and grey.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy, upbeat electronic BGM track. A clear male voice starts narrating with a playful tone. A sharp 'Pop' SFX punctuates the first visual transition, followed immediately by a bright 'Ding' as vegetables appear on screen. (2) As the narrator discusses being approachable, a double 'Ding-Ding' SFX triggers, synchronized with the farmer character appearing. The music maintains a steady 4/4 beat with synth textures. (3) A quick 'Whoosh' SFX accompanies a fast visual transition. The male voice remains high-pitched and enthusiastic. (4) A high-pitched, comical 'Boing' or 'Bubble' SFX sounds as the white mascot character appears. The BGM remains consistent in the background. (5) A distinct 'Paper Rustle' SFX is heard as the character displays the menu, followed by a 'Bell Ding' to highlight the menu options. The narration speed is moderate and clear. (6) A success-style 'Ta-da' chime sounds when the score rises from 7 to 8.08, indicating positive feedback. (7) Multiple 'Sparkle' and 'Pop' SFX occur in quick succession as positive personality traits are listed. The vocal pitch rises to show excitement. (8) Three distinct, low-pitched 'Pop' SFX play as negative trait bubbles appear, contrasting with the previous sparkles. (9) A comedic 'Slide' or 'Whistle' SFX plays during the final segment. The mascot lets out a high-pitched, exaggerated vocal cry of 'Yerr... No!', signifying humorous rejection of the vegetables.
